response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS average_signed_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS average_balance FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY average_balance DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no transactions of 2400 or more are excluded because their requested averages are undefined; averages for accounts with qualifying transactions are computed over all such transactions, while other or missing types contribute only to the balance average.
